counterfactual.change: Reduced dt from 0.006086 to 0.001 to increase substep resolution, preventing tunneling/penetration

explanation: At high speed (~76 m/s) and relatively large dt=0.006 with 16 substeps, body 1 impacts arena-adjacent wall 1 (at x=12.4, y=0, w=7.05, h=2.22). Substepping insufficient to resolve collision, causing positional correction failure and overlap 0.188 > 0.15 limit. Reducing dt to 0.001 eliminates penetration, indicating integration/collision tunneling handling bug at high velocity.
